name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days in São Paulo, where he volunteered to help a local racing team manage their data systems. His knack for problem-solving and optimizing network performance quickly made him indispensable. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science, he transitioned into a full-time role, honing his skills in managing complex IT infrastructures within the demanding environment of racing.

At Team Gtechniq, Rafael is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems, from race data acquisition and analysis to team communication and logistics. He is known for his proactive approach, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve team efficiency and data security. His flexible nature allows him to adapt quickly to changing priorities and unexpected challenges, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Rafael is of average height, with a focused and intelligent expression.

quirks: Always carries a small Rubik's Cube, solving it during downtime.
Has a habit of referring to IT problems as 'puzzles' that need to be solved.
Drinks mate tea throughout the day.
